Structures · editable builds

Parts use editable sketches. Loads remain loose unless a visible attachment is specified.

Gravity & contact · experimental

Build → run gravity → inspect → reset and improve. Standing on the ground does not anchor a part.

BUILD · simulation has not started

Contact supports and pushes. Attachment joins parts. Only an explicit world anchor holds a part fixed.

Part strength: select a part. Unassessed means no strength prediction.

Generic bonded patches model attachment strength; individual screws, welds and glue are not simulated. Part strength is separate. Contact and strength limits apply; these are experimental game estimates.
Attach surfaces

Click a planar face in the world, then capture it below. Repeat on the second part. The patch is centred at the first selected point.

No mating faces selected.

Faces must meet. Patches must fit both solid faces without crossing holes or edges.

Legacy mechanisms & beam experiment

Earlier projects retain their motion controls. Legacy joints are ideal connections and are separate from the new finite-strength surface attachments.

Engine challenges

Each build uses editable sketches and public modelling operations. Build recipes are included with the source.
Make a beam-and-load experiment
Try 100 kg, then 500 kg in a new experiment. Load mass comes from the iron block's dimensions. Strength is assessed only for supported beams/shafts with attached gravity loads. Other parts are unassessed. Reset before editing.

Select a face point for the pivot and normal, or enter parent-local metres. Then select the child. Connections preserve current positions.

    WELCOME TO CADCRAFT · 0.3.4
    Sketch it.
    Shape it.
    Make it yours.
    Your island is ready. Pull up a sketch, turn it into a solid, and build something of your own.
    01 · SketchOpen New sketch. Use dimensions and constraints to define your shape.
    02 · ShapeFinish, then Extrude or Revolve. Select a flat face to sketch more details.
    03 · BuildSave useful designs to your backpack. Place copies, assemble them, and paint each face.
    Move: WASD · Right-drag to look · F to fly
